prompts.name: create-deck
prompts.title: Make slides in Glance
prompts.description: Plans and builds a slide deck in Glance from a request, with a designed template, the slide-design skill and Glance's check.

arguments.name: request
arguments.description: What the slides are about and who they are for.

arguments.name: template
arguments.description: A template id from glance_templates, if the person chose one.

prompts.name: create-document
prompts.title: Make a document in Glance
prompts.description: Plans and writes a Glance document (a letter, report, CV, newsletter and so on) from a request, with a template, the document-writing skill and Glance's check.

arguments.name: request
arguments.description: What the document is and who it is for.

arguments.name: template
arguments.description: A template id from glance_templates, if the person chose one.

prompts.name: create-spreadsheet
prompts.title: Make a spreadsheet in Glance
prompts.description: Plans and builds a spreadsheet (.xlsx) in Glance from a request, with live formulas, the spreadsheet-building skill and Glance's check.

arguments.name: request
arguments.description: What the spreadsheet tracks or works out.

arguments.name: template
arguments.description: A template id from glance_templates, if the person chose one.

prompts.name: edit-file
prompts.title: Change a file in Glance
prompts.description: Makes a targeted change to a deck, document or spreadsheet in Glance: only what is asked, in the file's own look, then checks and looks at it.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: The file's absolute path. Default: the file open in Glance.
